entries.title: Ruth 4:1
segments:
The gate; to which men resorted to transact business. 
 
Punctuality in the transaction of business, and a habit of having every thing done at the right time and in the right way, are highly conducive to prosperity, usefulness, and enjoyment.

entries.title: Ruth 4:2
segments: He took ten men; to witness the transactions.

In the sale and conveyance of property, great care should be taken that the case be fairly stated and correctly understood by all concerned, that it be duly witnessed, and so conducted in all respects as to cut off all occasion of future misunderstanding and contention.

entries.title: Ruth 4:5
segments: To raise up the name of the dead; he must marry Ruth, as well as redeem or buy the land.

entries.title: Ruth 4:6
segments:
Cannot redeem it; that is, upon the condition just added by Boaz, which would impose upon him the burden of maintaining Ruth and Naomi, in addition to his own family. 
 
It is not wise for a man to purchase more property than he can pay for. Nor, if he has one wife, is it right for him to take another.  If he does, he violates the original law of marriage, and will find the way of transgressors to be hard.

entries.title: Ruth 4:7
segments: A testimony; that the man who gave the shoe transferred his right to the one who received it.

entries.title: Ruth 4:10
segments: Raise up the name of the dead; the eldest son would inherit the estate, and thus the name and inheritance of the family would be preserved.

entries.title: Ruth 4:11
segments:
Build the house; had a numerous posterity. 
 
  Ephratah-Bethlehem; different names of the place in which they lived. 
 
Marriage is an ordinance of God, which should be entered into in his fear, be solemnized before witnesses, and its duties so discharged that it may be a blessing to all concerned.

entries.title: Ruth 4:12
segments: Pharez; from whom Boaz and the Bethlehemites descended.

entries.title: Ruth 4:14
segments:
A kinsman; one who should perpetuate the name and inheritance of her family. 
 
The birth of a child is a just cause of rejoicing, and all interested should unite in supplication to God that it may live, be sanctified, and made a blessing to itself and its friends, to the church of God and the world.

entries.title: Ruth 4:17
segments:
Obed; meaning a servant, or one who would be serviceable.  From him descended David and Christ. 
 
Those who honor God he will honor, and make them blessings to all generations, even to the end of time and onward to eternity.  Blessed supremely, for ever blessed, are all who trust in obey him.
